Remacro and @resource/rally.webp@@resource/sheep.png@ until 11 (Your desired macro is 11f / 7w / 5g then rest to wood)
Start full-producing @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@@unit_infantry/archer-2.png@ and raid/look for good fights.

If up against @civilization_flag/mal.png@ or other raidable civs: go for mass feudal and get improved @technology_mongols/raid-bounty.png@ + @technology_mongols/stone-bounty.png@for 150res per house.

If against @civilization_flag/rus.png@@civilization_flag/eng.png@ focus on your trade boom instead of raiding. Try to contain your opponent and read into what strat is used from them (boom = outboom them, Aggro = play aggro too and take a good fight, FC = FC yourself with a few traders)
If against @civilization_flag/ott.png@ focus on making spears in dark age to deal with them early and prevent feudal age-up.
Your victory condition in the long run is to setup trade and outscale.

@abilities/repair.png@ a @building_economy/market.png@ and start trading (if the opponent is going Fast Castle you can go two @building_economy/market.png@ and be greedy while harassing the opponent}
Shift 4 @resource/resource_food.webp@@unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ to get wood for @unit_worker/trader.png@

keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.png@ (You can shift the @resource/resource_food.png@ @unit_worker/villager-mongols.png@ to other Resources like @resource/resource_wood.png@ or @resource/resource_gold.png@ depending on what you need the most

description:
As basic as possible Mongol build order for new players. Video below!

The goal is to be aggressive right from the Dark Age with a tower rush into mass Keshik and Archer. Alternatively, you can start with a fast pasture rather than tower rushing - check out the below video for more detail on the variations.

On the whole the Mongols have less of a refined build order as the game is a bit more chaotic with the impact of different spawns + dark age aggression. Think of this as more of a guideline for what you're trying to achieve than a strict build! Again, see the video for details.

Good luck!
name: New Player Guide to Mongols
author: Shaada

notes: Place @building_economy/town-center.webp@ by @resource/resource_wood.webp@, 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on nearest @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ with the @building_mongols/ger.webp@, 1 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ makes @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@

After @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ is finished, 3 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ go to tree by @building_economy/town-center.webp@, other 2 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.webp@. @abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@ @ @building_mongols/ovoo.webp@.

Double produce @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and go across the map with a @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ opponent's @resource/resource_gold.webp@ (see video for variants)
Train 3 more @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ (single + double production) and rally them across the map as well

Once enough @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for the 5 @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ + @building_defensive/outpost.webp@, re-macro to @resource/resource_food.webp@/@resource/resource_gold.webp@ and age up with 6 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ on @landmark_mongols/deer-stones.webp@
Rally to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ until 7 total, then back to @resource/resource_food.webp@ to 12. Get @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ when you can.
Train @unit_mongols/keshik-2.webp@ (1x double production) non-stop. Add @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and train @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ non-stop (double production when possible).
Send 5 @unit_worker/villager-mongols.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@ and research @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ (add an @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ when able)

Add @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ when able and research @technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@+@technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@. Slowly add @building_mongols/pasture.webp@ while being aggressive.
